text: This place is always HORRIBLY busy.  I chose to walk in but I regret, there were about 30 people starring at the order monitor but there were no order number at all.  After close to 40 minutes waiting for my 2 meals with 2 fries no salt, end up I got salt all over my hand and the food I got was cold.  Asked to change the hot fries with no salt and complained I had been waiting for my food over 30 mins.  The manager gave an attitude, "it is not my problem, we were busy", I said "so is that my problem? you are the manager on duty and not responsible the human power?"  She turned around and shout "it's not my problem, give her something hot".  I am patience enough to wait more than 30 mins for FAST FOOD and I deserve to receive this kind of "Customer service"????  The manager was trying to hide when I was taking her picture for evidence.  And other manager on duty was trying to cover her and asked me am I using human right.  There is nothing to do with human right but I was not treated right.  I brought it up to McDonald Headquarter about the incident I experienced at this location and asked for refund coz I threw them away.  The headquarter told me this restaurant manager would contact me within 10 business days but I never receive any phone call or email.  I received 2 meal coupons from Headquarter as a refund.  I will never ever come back again.  P.S. This restaurant is always full of garbage everywhere and no one was doing cleaning.
author: Me Me

text:
I came here to pick up an Uber Eats order and had a really bad experience. In the Uber app it clearly says that after 8 PM, orders should be picked up from the drive-thru. I followed the instructions, but the guy working there, named Chetanbir, was extremely rude.

When I showed him the Uber notes, he still refused to give me the order and said, “I will not give it, I am working here now. If you want it, come inside, otherwise cancel the order.” That’s not how you talk to people. Instead of helping, he started arguing with me, saying bad things about Uber drivers, like we don’t deserve respect.

Then it went even further—he insulted my family, including my mother, and even threatened to call 911 for no reason at all. This was shocking and very disrespectful. No one should have to go through that while just trying to do their job.

I recorded the whole thing on video, so I have proof of how badly he behaved. Honestly, McDonald’s should not keep people like this representing their store. I hope the manager looks into this because drivers like me just want to pick up food and move on, not be disrespected and abused. If the manager wants to see the video, please contact me and I can share it.
author: Sukhman singh Narang

text:
I am a regular late-night customer at this location, but what I’ve experienced recently has been extremely disappointing and unprofessional. Within the past month, I’ve witnessed behavior from the late-night manager, a woman named Sahil, that is completely unacceptable in a customer service role.

While I was dining in, I clearly overheard her gossiping with staff, using foul language, cussing about customers, and openly complaining in a sarcastic and negative tone. She had no idea I was listening, yet continued to speak this way in front of both staff and customers. As a paying guest, it was shocking and honestly very disrespectful.

This is not what customer service in Canada should represent. A manager sets the tone for the entire team, and when the person in charge is openly insulting customers and behaving unprofessionally, it ruins the entire atmosphere of the restaurant.

I strongly urge the GM of this location to address this issue immediately. Staff need to be reminded that customers come first, and that professionalism, respect, and courtesy are non-negotiable. If this behavior continues, it will drive loyal customers away.
author: Dave

text: Been an avid customer of McDonald kerrisdale location for a decade. Today I’m so disappointed for I ordered iced coffee fries and nuggets I their drive thru… the staff forgot to hand me my coffee for she seems busy talking to her colleagues or over the head set… I got my fries it’s saggy already I guest passed the holding time… nuggets not that fresh… today seems not a good day. Called their phone number, talked to the lady named sukh claiming she’s the manager… for I asked for the manager she said she is the store manager so I asked her again … she then asked for my name and spelled it out to her several times she still got it wrong saying it. She didn’t apologized she just insisted that the crew told me to wait for the iced coffee. Anyhow it’s disappointing the way she deal with me I think the store need to review how to deal with customers and how you do the customer service thing. For at first you apologized to the custome and you don’t argue… not coming back there again. I just missed the old crew who listens and very attentive now a days it changed so much bunch of youngsters who need to be taught customer service etiquette!
author: Rosale Lamason

text:
I was very upset and concerned to see a young employee handling ready-to-eat breakfast food with his bare hands and without wearing gloves.  Shouldn’t tongs be used to handle ready-to-eat foods like eggs and sausages, instead of bare hands? I was standing there waiting for my order for several minutes, and I saw him repeatedly picking up eggs with his hands, folding the sausage and placing it on the bagel, and covering it with the bun — all entirely with his bare hands.
I was so uncomfortable that I spoke to someone I believe was the manager. She told me that they use a timer for proper handwashing and that employees are allowed to handle food with bare hands.
This experience was very disappointing. I have always trusted McDonald’s as a company with well-trained staff and strong food safety standards. However, after seeing this with my own eyes—and hearing more and more negative reports—I am now very concerned about food safety.
I found this experience very unpleasant and unhygienic. Would you feel comfortable eating food handled this way? There are invisible germs that cannot be seen, and this raises serious concerns.
author: Aifen Situ

text: Consistently below average. Been going to this one for years because i live near by and the last few years have been terrible. Slow service. Major long wait times for drive thru. At least 50% chance your order will be wrong or missing something. Adjust anything if your order and expect it to be wrong. If you're looking for fast food at night, this isn't the place to go. You would have a quicker bite at subway or even a sit down restaurant nearby later at night. Screwed up my order one too many times. Ordered two burgers with meal last time. Got the wrong toppings on each (Angus and seriously chicken have choices), missing a box of fries, and had an extra burger (which was good I guess). Tonight, I saw the manger trying but the staff is incompetent. Again, my burger which was supposed to grilled ends up crispy. I waited 30 minutes in line, and 10 minutes after paying at the last window to still get the wrong order. Cold hard fries, no straw for drink. Messed up burger order.
author: N Y

text: Honestly I always thought it was a slightly below average McDonald's but the last two times I had horrible experiences. Last time the tables were extremely dirty and the staff didn't seem to care about it (even when covid is still a thing) and they took over 20 min in a McFlury.... I complained 3 times and only after the third time they did something about it (talk about fast food). The time before that one, the tables were super messy again and the trash was full and they didn't care to change it the whole time I was there. I think McDonald's is a great fast food chain restaurant, but this location is just a disgrace
author: alejandro mercado

text:
One of the nastiest branches. I had to ask them 3 times to give me a clean tray. First time the cashier guy had the audacity to give me a tray with an oiled paper and food residuals that is obviously not cleaned after being used by another diner. I asked to change it. He went back and changed the paper again with the same food pieces on the tray. I asked another lady to clean it. She wiped it, changed the paper and hand it back to me. It's just nasty and oily.
Regarding the food, the bread of egg and cheese mcmuffin was mushy and not roasted at all. Just soggy and a little wet. Too bad this is happening to McDonald's
author: Mohamed Ezzat

text:
Sad. Just sad. If you’re experiencing excessive happiness, this place will solve that for you. It starts with a long order placement wait time (took 5 minutes for cashier to even show up) and borderline theft in the form of automatic credit card charges when you’re standing there with a gift card. Then they take an excessive amount of time to give you a sad burger and some of the saddest fries known to man. This place used to be good, but now it’s truly awful.

The one star they get is out of pity for the manager who’s faced with grossly insufficient staff.

UPDATE (3/2024): the Coke machine is now broken as well
author: RandomAlpaca

text:
I’m quite disappointed with the experience here. This is a multicultural space, and I believe the staff should be more mindful of the environment. During my visit, Punjabi music was being played at an extremely loud volume, making it very difficult to enjoy a peaceful meal.

While I appreciate cultural diversity, there should be a basic level of respect for all customers  not everyone may be comfortable with such loud music in a dining area. I sincerely hope management takes this feedback seriously and creates a more inclusive and pleasant atmosphere moving forward
author: rajesh nagarajan

text: A disgrace.  I really do love McDonald's in general, but this is definitely the worst one I've been to.  Orders constantly wrong or missing something (egg BLT with missing egg, Caesar salad with no bacon and/or croutons, no napkins or straws...), waiting for up to 40 minutes for a simple order (!), super unfriendly staff (got a coupon for complaining on the website, then had to get into an argument with the manager who didn't want to accept the coupon)... It doesn't seem to matter whether it's night or day, busy or slow; it's always frustrating.
author: T B

text: I am really disappointed about the customer service. I got a wrong order, a junior chicken instead of a spicy Mac crispy from this Macdonald, so called them to resolve this issue. But the customer service is so disrespectful and rude, first she said that they do not do their own delivery service but I literally got my order from McDonald app delivery. Then she accused me of being fake even when I keep on trying to tell my side of the story. How can someone be so disrespectful and rude to their customer.
author: Joydeb Barman

text: Very disappointed with the service here. Every time I’ve had to deal with the manager (a girl named Vineet), it’s been the same negative experience. The wait times are always too long, and instead of providing help, she shows attitude and very poor customer service. Her unfriendly behavior and dismissive face make the whole visit unpleasant. I’ve been here many times, and it’s only when she is around that the service feels this unprofessional. Definitely not what you expect from McDonald’s.
author: E-shop express

text: I recently had an extremely disappointing experience at McDonald’s. After waiting for my food for half an hour, I ordered a Happy Meal for my son, only to find out alongside numerous other waiting customers that they were out of fries. When I explained that I needed to leave promptly due to my son’s daycare closing, the staff hastily put my order in a box without even bothering to seal it properly. It was, without a doubt, the worst experience I’ve ever had at a McDonald’s.
author: Oliver Faye

text:
I know it’s a McDonald’s but waiting 30 minutes for one order of fries in person is ridiculous. Had over 15 people waiting with me for about the same time. Showed my order on the “serving” screen, then they cleared it along with a bunch of other people just to make their system not look as backlogged.
Zero service. Had to flag them down and watch as they had no organization.
Highly recommend either training/better system/ or just go to a different McDonald’s.
author: Jay

text:
I understand this location is busy. However,  they only called my order once and put it aside. When I tried to get my order with my daughter, they gave me something wrong and I kept saying that is not my burger. The staff started to ignored me and I have to wait at 30 mins for a happy meal and 2 cookies.

I have been there few times, I don't mind to wait but I don't think ignoring a customer is a good idea. Horrible services.

text:

This isn’t the first time I’ve had issues, and even after sending complaints, no one has followed up or made improvements. The head office really needs to step in and do something to restore the quality and service standards at this unit.

text:
The top of my burger was hard — not toasted, not crisp, but hard — like a hockey puck. I thought Tim Hortons was the one with the hockey fetish.

For a moment, I considered going back and asking for a fresh one. But standing in line for another 15 minutes felt like losing twice. Maybe this wasn’t a mistake. Maybe it was a message from the universe.

Fast food that’s neither fast nor food. A clown at the helm. Fitting.

text:

This location in particular, keeps forgetting to put the condiments into the bag, even when ordered and showing on the receipt. Always forgetting the butter or syrup or ketchup.

Also, every place is arbitrarily moving the orders from the screen to serving and off of it, just so their seem to be on time and quick in the system/computer, but it’s all just a lie

This wasn’t an Uber issue — it was clearly a mistake on the restaurant’s side, and it was very disappointing given that multiple people were relying on this order. Poor service and accountability.

text:

I had to show my order number at the busy counter and inform them that my order hadn’t been served yet.
As a result, it took 13 minutes to get just ONE ice cream. The staff isn’t bad, but the system is absolutely terrible.
Table is nasty...

text: I went to McDonald’s for lunch and I ordered two chilli Junior chickens and a chicken cheese burger. On my chicken cheese burger they didn’t add the beef patty so it was basically just a cheese burger with a chicken patty instead of a beef patty. I also kindly asked for a water cup as I was very tired after 6 hours of work and they laughed in my face and proceeded to ignore me when I asked again.

text:
Every time I order ahead for pick-up at the W41 St McDonald’s, I still end up waiting at least 20 minutes — super slow.

Meanwhile, my friend who went through the drive-thru got their food almost immediately.

It really feels like pick-up orders are treated as the last priority here.

If you’re in a hurry, I don’t recommend ordering ahead. Just drive-thru or order on the spot — it’s way faster!
author: Kalen Wu

text:
Got a happy meal for my daughter last week and they gave us an old toy. She was very disappointed! Came back the following week and they refuse to swap the toy which is McDonald’s policy (as I used to work for Mcdonald’s).
They give you old toys when they run out of new ones, but won’t let you trade ones they give you! Do not come here for happy meals!
Manager needs training on Golden Moments!
author: Danny Ngo

text: One of the worst McDonald's. Ordered a hash brown on Boxing Day, it was cold and already rotten. I knew they closed on Christmas, but still! I was too busy on Boxing Day, otherwise I would report to food safety. Also ordered a toast bagle with requests to add extra butter and cut in half, but no butter and didn't cut in half, plus, it was cold too. This had happened multiple times already.

text: This location needs to hire MORE STAFF. It's not the crew's fault that orders take 20 minutes if you can count their size on one hand at peak hours. This is a very busy location, especially during Friday and weekend evenings. It's mind boggling how few staff are employed at any given time I visit. Seems like corporate is doing their best to cut costs and workers after their recent losses.
